name: Fire Cider Shot
subtitle: apple cider vinegar, ginger and chilli, left to steep for a fortnight

ingredients.note: raw and unfiltered, with the mother

steps.text: Pack the ginger, garlic, chilli and turmeric into a clean jar.
Pour over the vinegar until everything is submerged by a good centimetre. Cover the lid with baking paper first if it is metal; vinegar corrodes it.
Leave in a dark cupboard for two weeks, shaking daily.
Strain out the solids, pressing well, and stir the honey into the liquid. Take 15–30ml at a time.

storage: Six months in a sealed bottle at room temperature. The flavour deepens rather than fades.

provenance.note: Fire cider is North American folk medicine rather than Indian, popularised in the 1970s and now made in a hundred variations. It earns its place here on ingredients: ginger, garlic, turmeric and chilli are the same four things half of Indian cooking starts with.
